notes: `מִזְרְחָה הַשָּׁמֶשׁ` divides as *toward*(Sd) / *the*(article) / *sunrising*(`מִזְרָח` + `שֶׁמֶשׁ` fused under rule 30), exactly as rule 30's `דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים` → *chronicles* leaves the separately segmented article to take its own written *the*.
The *sunrising* fusion could alternatively be headed on `שֶׁמֶשׁ`; the governing construct `מִזְרָח` is kept as the syntactic head under rule 23.
*the kings of the land* is rule 29's arthrous case: nothing is fronted, the article on `אֶרֶץ` takes the *the* before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one.
